title.zh: CFTC Staff Advisory Says Prediction Market 'Mention' Contracts Invite Manipulation
title.en: CFTC Staff Advisory Says Prediction Market 'Mention' Contracts Invite Manipulation

current_state.zh: CFTC market oversight staff advised that prediction market contracts settling on whether a named person says certain words, appears somewhere, or interacts with others should be presumed readily susceptible to manipulation, with exchanges required to present heightened surveillance evidence to rebut the presumption.
current_state.en: CFTC market oversight staff advised that prediction market contracts settling on whether a named person says certain words, appears somewhere, or interacts with others should be presumed readily susceptible to manipulation, with exchanges required to present heightened surveillance evidence to rebut the presumption.
